instruction.text: Worüber wird gesprochen? Wähle richtig aus.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_chirp'>One thing I know for sure: I don't want to spend the rest of my life working from home. I need real social contact to keep me entertained.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6Us_chirp'>If I was given the chance to see myself in 20 years, I think I would want to see it. I would love to find out what the future holds for me.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m11_chirp'>Most people just plan what kind of profession they want to have as an adult. They should rather think about what their personal dreams are and how they want to achieve them.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m5_chirp'>It is important to remember that our choices determine our lives. That means we can actively influence our path by making changes in our daily lives or future plans.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10_chirp'>I am definitely not going to work in a job I don't like. I would rather earn less money and enjoy what I do than earn more but drag myself to work every day.</voice>

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_chirp'>What is the point of studying if graduates can't find a job despite their education? I feel like the free market has something to offer anyone as long as they can sell themselves well.</voice>

instruction.text: Höre dir Killians Meinung zu sozialen Medien in der Zukunft an und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.sound: Personally, I think that social media has a negative impact on us. In multiple regards. Firstly, it is massively addictive. We spend so much time online which would be better invested in real life activities that actually benefit us.

atoms.a: What does Killian think of social media?
b: It is a nice way to spend your free time and stay in contact with friends.
It is highly dangerous and should be banned immediately.
++It influences us negatively in multiple ways.

instruction.text: Höre dir Killians Meinung zu sozialen Medien in der Zukunft an und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.sound: Additionally, social media makes us think differently about ourselves due to the constant comparisons we make. What we would usually consider as amazing seems much less great after comparing it to the fake world on social media.

atoms.a: What else does he criticise about the platforms?
b: Social media reinforces comparison with others which helps economic growth.
Social media is an empowering place that values every member and makes them feel seen.
++Social media makes our big moments in life seem insignificant.

instruction.text: Höre dir Killians Meinung zu sozialen Medien in der Zukunft an und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.sound: Therefore, I think in the future we would be better off without social media. Of course, it is important to stay connected and also many jobs rely on it. Nevertheless, if the negative consequences dominate, we need to prioritize our mental health.

atoms.a: What does Killian propose for the future of social media?
b: Everyone should decide for themselves if they would want to live without social media or not.
Social media needs to live on since it is essential for many brands and employees.
++We should prioritize our mental health and leave social media behind.

instruction.text: Höre dir Killians Meinung zu sozialen Medien in der Zukunft an und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.sound: I envision a great future without social media. We will be more social again by meeting up with friends more often and having honest and open conversations instead of scrolling on phones or constantly looking something up. Furthermore, since we wouldn't be able to see all the other opportunities anymore we might stick to plans more reliably.

atoms.a: What does Killian think would change without social media?
b: Some people will benefit from the loss of connectedness, others might not like it.
He doesn't think things will actually change, we will just feel better.
++People would meet up in person more and be more outgoing.

parentTopic.title: What will happen in the future?
